description: In every PA-model, any beta code \((c,d)\), length \(n\) and value \(a\) admit a code \((c^{\prime},d^{\prime})\) with value \(a\) at \(n\) and the same decoded values as \((c,d)\) at every \(i\lt n\). The length and indices may be nonstandard.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.beta_extension_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (c d n a : M) :
  ∃ c' d',
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c' d' n a ∧
      ∀ (i : M),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) n →
          ∀ (z : M),
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c' d' i z ↔
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c d i z
